source_checks.finding: Page confirms the exact words: 'Don't trust the voice.', 'Call the person who supposedly contacted you and verify the story.', 'Use a phone number you know is theirs.', 'If you can't reach your loved one, try to get in touch with them through another family member or their friends.' Applies to any call or message from someone claiming to be a family member in trouble, as the ref states.

Page confirms: 'Anyone who says you can only pay in one of these ways is probably a scammer.' and 'Never send money to anyone who says you can only pay with a specific payment method, no matter what reason they give you.' Published July 22, 2026. Applies to any payment request, as the ref states.
Same page as fam-ftc2023-verify. Page confirms: 'If you spot a scam, report it to the FTC at ReportFraud.ftc.gov.' Applies to any suspected scam, as the ref states.

required_actions.action: Verify the story by calling the daughter at a phone number already known to be hers before sending any money
If the daughter cannot be reached, contact her through another family member or her friends
Do not wire money, since the request insists on one payment method (wire)
Report the suspected scam to the FTC at ReportFraud.ftc.gov
